_doc: Posted bills (docs/STEALTH.md 3.6, phase E), read by scripts/stealth/intel.gd. `places`: where paper goes. A place `on: notice_board` is local to the dressing's notice board (x across, y up, z out of the board face); a wall place casts a ray from `from` along `dir` and pastes the bill where it hits a building, `y` metres up. `bills`: each shown line is [text, gloss]; `heading` goes on the paper itself, `lines` into the journal Log when read (E). `wanted` bills appear only at notoriety >= wanted.min_notoriety and are written from the player's origin, sex and coat (wanted.origins). Tearing a bill down (E again once read) costs the watch a bill: notoriety -5, crackdown +1 if a guard sees it.

bills.title: The curfew proclamation
heading: BEKANNTMACHUNG
Proclamation
Obwieszczenie
Notice
lines: Nach der zehnten Abendstunde hat sich niemand ohne Laterne und Passierschein auf den Gassen aufzuhalten.
After the tenth hour of the evening no one is to be abroad in the streets without a lantern and a pass.
Po dziesiątej wieczorem nikt nie wychodzi na ulicę bez latarni i przepustki.
After ten in the evening no one goes out without a lantern and a pass.
Die Glocke von St. Marien gibt das Zeichen. Die Wache ist angewiesen, jeden Verdächtigen anzuhalten.
The bell of St Mary's gives the signal. The watch is ordered to stop anyone suspicious.
bills.note: Curfew at ten, rung from St Mary's; after the bell the watch looks twice as far for a few minutes.

bills.title: The order of the watch
heading: WACHORDNUNG
Order of the watch
lines: Posten bei St. Marien: der Herr Korporal. Ablösung der Posten um Mitternacht.
Post at St Mary's: the Corporal. The posts are relieved at midnight.
Zwei Rundgänge über den Ring: Nordseite und Rathausseite, ohne Unterlass.
Two rounds of the square: the north side and the Town Hall side, without pause.
Der Posten an den Tuchhallen tritt zur Ablösung bei St. Marien an.
The Cloth Hall sentry reports to St Mary's for the relief.
bills.note: Watch rota: the Corporal holds St Mary's post; patrols walk the north side and the Town Hall side; at midnight the Cloth Hall sentry leaves to be relieved at St Mary's.

bills.title: A theatre bill
heading: THEATER
Theatre
Die Zauberflöte
The Magic Flute
lines: Heute Abend im Theater am Ring: Die Zauberflöte, eine große Oper von Herrn Mozart.
Tonight at the theatre on the square: The Magic Flute, a grand opera by Herr Mozart.
Na dole ręką dopisano: Krakowiacy i Górale, czwartek, za zamkniętymi drzwiami.
Written underneath by hand: Krakowiacy and Górale, Thursday, behind closed doors.
bills.note: Under the German opera bill someone has pencilled a private performance of Bogusławski's banned 'Krakowiacy and Górale'.

bills.title: The magistrate's lamp order
heading: Magistrat
The Town Council
O latarniach
On the lanterns
lines: Latarnik obchodzi Rynek przez całą noc. Kto latarnię zgasi, zapłaci grzywnę.
The lamplighter goes round the square all night. Whoever puts out a lantern pays a fine.
Zgaszoną latarnię zapala na nowo latarnik albo straż.
A lantern put out is lit again by the lamplighter or the watch.
bills.note: A doused lantern is soon relit, by the lamplighter or a guard who notices it.

bills.title: A notice of new taxes
heading: PATENT
Imperial decree
Podatek
Tax
lines: Auf Befehl Seiner Majestät: eine neue Abgabe auf Salz, Bier und Tuch.
By order of His Majesty: a new levy on salt, beer and cloth.
Z rozkazu Jego Cesarskiej Mości: nowy podatek od soli, piwa i sukna.
By order of His Imperial Majesty: a new tax on salt, beer and cloth.
bills.note: A new Austrian levy on salt, beer and cloth. The guilds will be angry.

heading: GESUCHT
Wanted
POSZUKIWANY
Wanted
intro: Wegen Aufruhrs und nächtlichen Umtriebs wird gesucht:
Wanted for sedition and prowling by night:

coat: in a claret kontusz with a sabre sash
trait: spricht wie ein Herr, trägt einen Siegelring
speaks like a gentleman, wears a signet ring
Tinte an den Fingern, lange Haare
ink on the fingers, long hair

coat: in a grey peasant's coat, a sukmana
trait: hinkt ein wenig, Narbe am Arm, ohne Papiere
limps a little, a scar on the arm, no papers

coat: in a brown burgher's coat with brass buttons

reward: Belohnung: fünfzig Gulden. Nagroda: pięćdziesiąt złotych.
Reward: fifty gulden. Reward: fifty złoty.
